scope_rationale: Corpus bitmap/inverted/zone indexes require maintained query semantics beyond generic containers; exact code search found no existing implementation. Gap-buffer/piece-table/zipper candidates were instead mapped to actual T70 evidence.

outcomes: Derive and implement the exact bitmap representation and operations in the shared contract.
Preserve bitmap invariants and failure publication under replacement, invalid inputs and boundaries.
Falsify incorrect bitmap implementations using an independent raw-row oracle and semantic mutants.
Measure bitmap workload/storage costs and independently implement the named changed-condition contract.
